behaviorRules: TDD & spec-first: Tests before implementation; define contracts and boundary matrices (spec-driven-development).
Operator first principles: Continuous memory (SoA), LUT/SWAR, and O(1) epoch reuse (algorithmic-operator-engineering).
Minimal change surface: Touch only files required for the task; zero gratuitous formatting or unrelated changes.
Degradation defense: Guard empty inputs, max sizes, timeouts, and path sanitization before writing core logic.
Pre-delivery triple verification: Pass clean build, test regression, and static rule gates before delivery.
